newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO GIVES NEW PARTNER CASH WINNING FEELING.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-HELISSIO GIVES NEW PARTNER CASH WINNING FEELING.

text.p: The new partnership of Helissio and Cash Asmussen got off to flying start in the Group One Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud on Sunday.
The French superstar, very much at home on a soft ground, had little difficulty in repeating last year's win in the mile and a half (2.4 km) event.
Helissio set out to make all under the Texan. They were followed by Riyadian and Darazari with Magellano bringing up the rear of the quartet.
Riyadian and Darazari both weakened in the straight as Helissio, a 10-1 on shot, cruised home by five lengths from Magellano.
The British runner Riyadian was further three lengths back in third, with Darazari, unsuited by the going, all of 12 lengths adrift of the winner in last.
Helissio now goes for the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Diamond Stakes at Ascot on July 26, having left Asmussen suitably impressed.
He said: "He has a very high cruising speed and class in abundance. I have absolute confidence that he will acquit himself well in the King George."

Helissio will then be aimed at a repeat triumph in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Asmussen has taken over on the colt from Olivier Peslier who is required for Peintre Celebre, the French Derby winner.
